svg.title: The prices are real: weekly CMS NADAC acquisition costs. NADAC is what retail pharmacies pay on average, not what any hospital's contract says. The hospitals and their purchases are made up, generated with a fixed seed, labelled synthetic everywhere, and the database refuses a row that doesn't say so.
